build_credit_gain_scorer: build a custom scorer using credit_gain_score to optimize a classifier by minimizing misclassification costs with a gain matrix
build_business_metric_scorer: build a business metric scorer for fraud detection that computes profit based on transaction amounts and confusion matrix outcomes
tune_threshold_classifier: tune the decision threshold of a classifier using TunedThresholdClassifierCV to maximize a custom business scoring metric
set_fixed_threshold: set a fixed decision threshold on a classifier using FixedThresholdClassifier with a FrozenEstimator to avoid refitting
plot_roc_pr_curves: plot ROC and Precision-Recall curves comparing vanilla and threshold-tuned classifiers with annotated cut-off points
